notes: BNEF counts 112 GW / 307 GWh of new storage added worldwide in 2025, up 48%, with 54% in China and 16% in the US. The IEA and China's National Energy Administration both put the figure at about 110 GW. China's National Energy Administration reports cumulative new-type storage of 136 GW / 351 GWh at end-2025, up 84.3%, with an average duration of 2.58 hours and lithium batteries making up 96.1%. In BNEF's annual survey, stationary storage battery packs averaged $70/kWh, down 45%, the cheapest of any use for the first time. Storage is what moves solar out of the midday hours. BNEF forecasts 158 GW / 459 GWh of additions in 2026. The image is AI-generated and illustrative.
